svg.aria-label: The plan-orchestration skill: every open plan, step by step. Boxes: The next unblocked step of the earliest plan, for each free slot (a step of the session); /spec: the brief, the brief check of a full step, the worktree (a step of the session); A wrong premise (stop); Builder agent in the step's worktree, unless the executor is inline or academic-paper (agent, only when needed); A model other than the configured one (stop); The report saved and the whole diff read, then /refute when review: calls for it (a step of the session); Builder, resumed: a repair round, each finding with its ruling (agent, only when needed); A finding that is the user's (stop); /land: the step on main, booked (a step of the session); A red check (stop); The roadmap diff (stop); A shape nobody named (stop); A rule clash (stop).
